notable_absence.finding: The Query Monitor tab lets a user filter active queries by a 'Longer than' time value entered in ms/s/m, and pause them, but the page never states what happens to a paused query afterward (whether it is killed, queued, or resumable), nor what privilege beyond role:fts-admin (if any) is needed specifically to pause another user's in-flight query.
